name: inkwell
description: Inkwell — a Medium-inspired publishing MVP (Next.js + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n inkwell-api,inkwell-web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter inkwell-api dev" "pnpm --filter inkwell-web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter inkwell-api build && pnpm --filter inkwell-web build
scripts.start: concurrently -n inkwell-api,inkwell-web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter inkwell-api start" "pnpm --filter inkwell-web start"
